description: The image displays a set of three pie charts, labeled "easy," "medium," and "hard," positioned above the text "Zero-Shot," which collectively compare the proportions of four distinct categories across these three conditions. A shared legend on the right identifies the four categories by color: N+K+ (dark teal), N-K+ (brown), N-K- (light brown), and N+K- (reddish-brown). Each of the three pie charts contains exactly four slices, with percentage labels displayed directly inside each segment, and no slices are visually emphasized, exploded, or offset. In the "easy" chart, the slices appear in descending order of size clockwise, consisting of N+K+ at 55.4%, N-K+ at 38.3%, N-K- at 4.6%, and N+K- at 1.7%. Similarly, the "medium" chart's segments are visually ordered by descending size clockwise, showing N+K+ at 58.8%, N-K+ at 35.4%, N-K- at 4.0%, and N+K- at 1.8%. The "hard" chart displays a different distribution, with the light brown N-K- slice at 37.9%, the brown N-K+ slice at 37.3%, the dark teal N+K+ slice at 18.1%, and the reddish-brown N+K- slice at 6.7%.
